caption:
Creative fatigue isn't your audience getting bored of your ad.

It's the algorithm running out of new people who would respond to it.

Every ad finds its pocket of people first. Once that pocket is used up, it starts showing to the same faces again (frequency goes up) and to people who were never a fit (cost per lead goes up).

That's why changing the color, the font or the music rarely fixes it. Same message, same pocket.

A new angle reaches a new pocket:
→ Different problem, same service
→ Different customer type, same offer
→ Different reason to buy now

Comment "ANGLE" and tell me your niche. I'll reply with 3 angles you probably haven't tried.
